title: EverydayScience BeverageCooling

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the beverage cooling analysis research task. Implemented Newton's Law of Cooling modeling, identified an intervention at 80 minutes, analyzed two distinct cooling segments, created comprehensive visualizations, and produced a detailed research report with all required components. Key findings: Segment 1 follows Newton's Law perfectly (R²=1.000, T_env=25°C, k=0.01155 min⁻¹), Segment 2 shows faster cooling (k=0.02209 min⁻¹) with different parameters, indicating changed conditions after intervention.
